obligations.definition: This native CLINT has one clock and synchronous active-high reset. State updates only on rising clock edges. Observe combinational outputs after propagation settles. Legal active requests outside reset use opcode 0 (PutFull), 1 (PutPartial), or 4 (Get), param zero, corrupt zero, source 0..767, address[25:16]=0x200, naturally aligned size 0..3 corresponding to 1,2,4,8 bytes, and a byte mask contained within the addressed size/lanes; Get and PutFull use every addressed byte lane. A stalled A request retains valid and payload until accepted. Protocol monitor assertions remain enabled. X/Z numerical behavior is unspecified, except the comparison-register initialization rule below.

obligations.definition: Reset sets the 64-bit timer to zero and overrides writes and io_rtcTick. Otherwise an accepted non-Get transfer to offsets0xbff8..0xbfff with any asserted mask byte updates each selected byte from the same byte lane of A data, preserving unselected bytes; any such write overrides ticking for the entire timer. coverage_policy: The fixed R obligations and five-dimensional denominator remain unchanged. All tests may be combined; stimulus cannot be supplied by inference from expected/given feature/names. Basic legal observable cases earn partial-domain credit; full credit requires satisfying both the complete domain and the boundaries. A locally invalid checker does not remove independent checker support already provided by other tests.
